reviewer_requirement: independent reviewer that did not author or mutate the candidate bytes
obligations: Confirm the Lean term preserves the universal ALLOW biconditional exactly.
Confirm the Lean term preserves the universal DENY-as-complement biconditional exactly.
Confirm the admissible exact-match, admissible no-match, and inadmissible request witnesses are all preserved.
Confirm the v4 and v5 formal signatures denote the same sorts, functions, predicates, and ALLOW/DENY constants.
Confirm the Lean inductive AuthorizationDecision closes the codomain to exactly ALLOW and DENY without adding a new business assumption.
Confirm InterpretationModel remains outside FormalClaim identity and joins only through external EvaluationContext.
Confirm the marked Lean source term exactly equals the v5 canonical proposition bytes and elaborates in the pinned core-only environment.
Confirm the lean-dtt profile result semantics and claim ceiling do not imply theorem success, runtime correspondence, or release evidence.
Report every dependent check as pass, block, or not_evaluable with causal evidence; do not omit blocked checks.
forbidden_inferences: FormalClaim admission implies theorem proof or EVF PASS
theorem evidence implies Auth implementation or production security
claim_ceiling: Independent-review request over exact immutable inputs. It is not the review result, profile admission, FormalClaim admission, theorem evidence, runtime correspondence, release, deployment, or production authority.
